title: Circuit breaker
summary: Build the closed, open and half-open state machine that stops calling a failing dependency, fails fast while it recovers, and probes it with a few trial calls before letting traffic back.
hints: The breaker is three states and a few counters: consecutive failures (closed), when it opened (open), and trials admitted and succeeded (half-open). Nothing else is needed for this model.
Don't use a timer to leave the open state. Store opened_at and, whenever state() is asked, switch to half-open if now() - opened_at >= reset_timeout. Every other method goes through state() first.

allow_request raises when open, or when half-open and the trial quota is used up; otherwise it counts the trial. A failure while half-open reopens with a fresh opened_at; enough half-open successes close and zero the failure count. call is allow_request, then fn, then record the outcome and re-raise fn's own error.
